correctness.rationale: Direct-summand restriction to connected commutative A gives constant rank. At a stable residue with trivial G-action, fiber is a projective over K[G]; this modular p-group algebra is local by central order-p subgroup induction, making fiber free of rank j and A-rank j|G|. Diagonal matrices attain all ranks, and rank 0/full give only 0,1. The Artin–Schreier trace identity yields a nontrivial rank-one idempotent when the fixed-residue condition fails; independent polynomial-skew enumeration checks examples.

value.rationale: The projective rank image |G|Z is a natural exact invariant across connected commutative bases without Noetherianity or domain assumptions. It detects noncentral idempotent absence and extends an explicitly excluded 2023 characteristic-two infinite-dihedral case. The translation example produces a nontrivial idempotent with A-rank one once fixed-residue is lost, demonstrating a mathematically essential boundary, not a routine restatement of locality of kG.
